First, find the first derivative of the function, f’(x). Then, set f’(x) = 0 to find critical points. Determine their nature by checking the second derivative, f''(x). If f''(x) > 0, it’s a minimum; if f''(x) < 0, it’s a maximum.
replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA simplifies data by reducing dimensions.
